shellCommands.command: git diff package.json && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat tsconfig.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace; for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)"
cd /workspace; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/*.d.ts; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50

cd /workspace/node_modules/next; cat error.d.ts; grep -rn "ErrorInfo\b" dist/api/error.d.ts dist/client/components/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -nE "PageProps|LayoutProps|RouteContext|params" dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md | head -20; grep -nE "RouteContext|params|ctx" dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md | head -30
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config; ls; sed -n 1,80p index.md | grep -v '^$'; head -40 ../not-found.md | grep -v '^$'
git rm -rq pages components/AppProvider.js && printf '.next/\nnext-env.d.ts\n' >> .gitignore && ls -R app components lib && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
B=http://localhost:3123
for p in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/42 /blog/99999 /nope; do printf '%-14s %s ' $p "$(curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w '%{http_code}' $B$p)"; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/out.html | head -1; done
curl -s $B/api/posts; echo
curl -s -XPOST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"a","content":"b"}' -w ' %{http_code}\n' $B/api/posts
curl -s -XPOST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"a"}' -w ' %{http_code}\n' $B/api/posts
curl -s -XPOST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{bad' -w ' %{http_code}\n' $B/api/posts
curl -s $B/api/posts/7; echo
curl -s -XPUT -w ' %{http_code}\n' $B/api/posts/7
curl -s -XDELETE -w ' %{http_code}\n' $B/api/posts/7
curl -s -XPATCH -D - -o /dev/null $B/api/posts/7 | grep -iE '^(HTTP|allow)'
grep -o 'Your user agent: [^<]*' <(curl -s $B/)
pkill -f 'next start'; grep -i error /tmp/next.log | head

cd /workspace; npx next build 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|Error|✓ Compiled|Finished TypeScript' ; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
for p in /blog/99999 /blog/3; do printf '%-14s %s ' $p "$(curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w '%{http_code}' localhost:3123$p)"; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/out.html | head -1; done
kill $(pgrep -f 'next-server|next start') 2>/dev/null; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK; git status --short
cd /workspace; pgrep -fa next-server | head -2; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
cd /workspace; kill 656; printf 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo\n' >> .gitignore; cat .gitignore; ls pages 2>&1
